Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
estilo
Wikipedia pt

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • estylo (pre-standardization spelling)
  • estyllo (obsolete)
  • estillo (obsolete)

Etymology

[edit]

Probably borrowed from Latin stilus (“stylus”), from Proto-Indo-European *(s)teyg- (“pierce”). Doublet of esteio (inherited) and style (borrowed from English).

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /isˈt͡ʃi.lu/, /esˈt͡ʃi.lu/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /isˈt͡ʃi.lu/, /esˈt͡ʃi.lu/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /iʃˈt͡ʃi.lu/, /eʃˈt͡ʃi.lu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /esˈt͡ʃi.lo/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /(i)ʃˈti.lu/

  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: es‧ti‧lo

Noun

[edit]

estilo m (plural estilos)

  1. style (manner of doing things)
  2. stylus (writing instrument)
  3. (Portugal, swimming) stroke (a particular style of swimming)
    Synonym: nado
  4. (Portugal, swimming, in the plural) medley
    Synonym: (Brazil) medley
    Vou participar na prova de 100m estilos. ― I will compete in the 100m medley.
  5. (botany) style, stylet (the stalk that connects the stigma to the ovary in a pistil of a flower)
    Synonym: estilete

Derived terms

[edit]
  • (sense 1) estiloso; estilista
  • (sense 5) heterostilia

Further reading

[edit]
  • “estilo”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “estilo”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /esˈtilo/ [esˈt̪i.lo]
  • Rhymes: -ilo
  • Syllabification: es‧ti‧lo

Etymology 1

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin stilus.

Noun

[edit]

estilo m (plural estilos)

  1. style (way of doing things)
  2. style (grace; fashionable skill)
  3. (botany) style
  4. stylus
Hyponyms
[edit]

  • estilo indirecto libre
  • estilo libre

Descendants

Tagalog

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • istilo

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish estilo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔesˈtilo/ [ʔɛsˈt̪iː.lo]
  • Rhymes: -ilo
  • Syllabification: es‧ti‧lo

Noun

[edit]

estilo (Baybayin spelling ᜁᜐ᜔ᜆᜒᜎᜓ)

  1. style; manner; method
    Synonyms: paraan, pamamaraan
  2. style; fashion
    Synonyms: uso, moda
  3. stylus
